turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Standard shipping time can vary a bit because we let you choose your timing at checkout rather than using a fixed “3–5 business days” model.

Here’s how it works:

• United States:

At checkout, you’ll see a delivery calendar and can choose your preferred estimated arrival date.
The dates shown already factor in the time we need to prepare your plants plus standard carrier transit time to your address.

• Canada (eligible regions):

You choose a preferred ship week at checkout.
Orders are shipped during that week, then typically take about 2 business days once they cross the border and are scanned by the carrier.

All delivery dates and timeframes are estimates, since weather and carrier delays can affect timing. You can also schedule delivery up to about 8 months in advance so your plants arrive when it’s safe to plant in your area.

If you tell me your country/region, I can describe more specifically what you’ll see at checkout for your location.
